title: Souvenirs From Tanzania Worth Bringing Home
excerpt: From kangas to coffee and Tingatinga paintings: souvenirs worth bringing home from Tanzania, and what to avoid.
body:
## Worth buying

- **Kangas and kitenge:** colourful printed fabrics, often with a Swahili saying on kangas.
- **Tingatinga paintings.** See [Tingatinga workshop](/blog/tingatinga-painting-workshop/).
- **Coffee** from Kilimanjaro or Arusha. See [Tanzanian coffee](/blog/tanzanian-coffee/).
- **Spices** from Zanzibar.
- **Maasai beadwork.**
- **Woodcarvings** from sustainable wood.
- **Tanzanite** from licensed dealers. See [tanzanite](/blog/tanzanite-guide/).

## Avoid

- Ivory, shells, coral, animal skins and turtle shell: illegal and harmful.
- Ebony and other endangered woods without certification.

## Bargaining

In markets, bargaining is normal. Be friendly and fair.

## Customs

Check what you can import into your home country.
